items.prompt: Transliterate this Hebrew word into Latin script
items.answer: It hasto be remembered that the naturally long vowel, while it very frequently has consonantal representation, does not have it invariably or inevitably. fore, the vocalic consonant is omitted, only a knowledge of forms, to be acquired later, enables us to decide whether the vowel in question is pure long or tone-long

source.citation: Davidson, Introductory Hebrew Grammar (22nd ed.) exercise on §3; Key to the Exercises (1924) §3
